turns.text: Hello, main Sunrise Power Board se bol raha hoon. Aapka bijli connection aaj raat nau baje kaat diya jayega, teen hazaar chaar sau pachaas rupaye ka bill pending hai.
Sir jaldi payment kijiye warna connection disconnect ho jayega. Abhi turant.
Theek hai baba, UPI app kholiye aur payment kijiye.
Agar nahi hua to supervisor ka number hai nau aath saat chhe paanch chaar teen do ek shunya, call kar lena.
Payment fail ho gaya? Phir se karo, jaldi karo.
Haan refund.desk@ybl. Account number bhi note kar lo, account number 1234 5678 9012 aur IFSC S B I N zero zero zero one two three four.
Jaldi karo baba, der mat karo.
